title: File Recovery – Photo & Video
summary: Recover deleted photos & videos, clean junk files, and protect privacy easily
description:
RecoX – File Recovery & Photo Video Restore
Recover, Clean & Protect Your Files in One App

Accidentally deleted important photos or videos? Running out of storage because of junk files or duplicates?
RecoX – File Recovery & Photo Video Restore is an all-in-one tool that helps you recover lost media, clean unnecessary files, and keep your private photos and videos secure — all in one simple and safe app.

With a powerful scanning engine and smart file management tools, you can easily restore deleted photos and videos, free up storage space, and protect your sensitive files without complicated steps or root access.

🔄 Recover Deleted Photos & Videos

Quickly scan your device to find deleted photos and videos that are still recoverable.

✔ Fast and easy photo & video recovery
✔ Restore files in original quality
✔ Preview before recovery to select exactly what you need
✔ One-tap restore to your gallery

🧹 Clean Junk Files & Free Up Storage

Get rid of unnecessary files and reclaim valuable space on your device.

✔ Remove cache, temporary files, and leftover junk
✔ Clean large files you no longer need
✔ Improve device performance with just a few taps

📸 Remove Duplicate Photos & Videos

Avoid wasting storage with repeated or similar files.

✔ Find duplicate and similar photos automatically
✔ Compare and delete duplicates safely
✔ Organize your gallery more efficiently

🔍 Find & Manage Large Files

Easily locate files that take up too much space.

✔ Sort files by size
✔ Identify storage-hogging videos and photos
✔ Delete or move large files in one place

🔐 Photo & Video Vault – Protect Your Privacy

Keep your personal photos and videos safe with a built-in private vault.

✔ Hide sensitive photos and videos securely
✔ Access protected files with PIN or pattern
✔ Prevent unauthorized access to your private media

⚙️ Simple, Safe & No Root Required

Designed for everyone, RecoX – File Recovery & Photo Video Restore works without root access and does not require complex settings.

✔ No root needed
✔ Easy-to-use interface
✔ Works fully on your device
✔ No file upload required

⚠️ Important Notes

Recovery results depend on your device, storage condition, and whether files have been overwritten.

Files removed by factory reset or securely wiped may not be recoverable.

The app only scans local storage. Cloud-only files (such as Google Drive or Google Photos cloud items) cannot be recovered.

All scans are read-only and do not modify your existing data. Recovered files are saved to a separate folder.

🌟 All-in-One File Solution

Whether you want to recover deleted photos and videos, clean junk files, remove duplicates, manage large files, or protect your private media, RecoX – File Recovery & Photo Video Restore gives you everything you need in one lightweight and reliable app.

Download now and take full control of your photos, videos, and storage! 🚀
